inventory_completeness.label: full_book_screened_under_explicit_policy
screened: All 156 numbered Examples and all 175 Figures in Chapters 1–11 and Appendices A–C
Main-text unnumbered numerical studies, including algorithm convergence and sensitivity sweeps
All 23 official CVXOPT book-example pages, their linked scripts and all 9 data files
Official CVX book-example MATLAB sources relevant to included studies and companion-only borderline cases
Every linked Stanford chapter 9–11 MATLAB script
inventory_completeness.scope_caveat: Comprehensive screening under an explicit numerical-output policy, not a claim that all mathematical Examples are computational tasks. Study grouping is documented. Official code/data availability does not establish a verified reproduction or exact figure match. No instructor solution manual was used.
inventory_completeness.unresolved_scope: Some drawings are conceptual boundary cases; screening_audit gives explicit decisions so the inclusion policy is reviewable.

policy.include: Concrete numerical instances with a worked numerical answer, computed solution plot or substantive numerical experiment in the main text. Include tiny explicit numerical answers even when obtained analytically. Include reported studies whose original data are missing, with that limitation recorded.
policy.exclude: End-of-chapter exercises; arbitrary-data symbolic derivations; generic modeling examples without a numerical result; pure definitions/function plots and conceptual diagrams. Numerical companion instantiations alone do not turn symbolic textbook examples into numerical worked examples.
policy.grouping: A numbered Example is one entry; related figures for the same numerical study are grouped. Different algorithms on a reused instance may have separate entries when presented as separate studies. Entry count is a study count, not a figure count.
policy.status: Every entry starts pending. Data/code availability and catalog completion are not reproduction completion. Verified implementations are tracked separately.
policy.exactness: Exact_data_available concerns published instance inputs, not numerical verification or pixel identity. Official_seeded_generator requires legacy MATLAB RNG semantics; the same NumPy integer seed is insufficient. A method-only reproduction must disclose substituted data.

entries.title: Scalar optimal values, attainment, and unboundedness
expected_outputs: For f(x)=1/x on x>0: infimum 0, not attained.
For f(x)=-log(x) on x>0: objective unbounded below, infimum -infinity.
For f(x)=x log(x) on x>0: unique minimizer x*=1/e approximately 0.3678794412; optimal value -1/e approximately -0.3678794412.
entries.data_availability: All three scalar objective functions and their common domain x>0 are explicitly supplied.
notes: Small analytically solved numerical instances, retained under the inventory rule that a concrete instance with an explicit numeric result qualifies even without a numerical algorithm. The first two have no finite attained optimizer; a bounded-domain numerical approximation must not be mistaken for an optimizer.
